atomic_facts.fact: Carlos Ghosn's full name is Carlos Ghosn.
He was CEO of Michelin North America.
He was chairman and CEO of Renault.
He was chairman and CEO of Nissan.
He was chairman of Mitsubishi Motors.
In 2018, Carlos Ghosn was arrested in Japan on suspicion of financial misconduct at Nissan.
In 2019, Carlos Ghosn was under house arrest in Japan awaiting trial.
He was under house arrest awaiting trial in November 2019 specifically.
Carlos Ghosn escaped from Japan in 2019.
He departed Japan specifically in December 2019.
He escaped by concealing himself inside a large box that was shipped as freight on a private jet.
